verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a local chat and model-management app, but the evidence pack never documents exporting chats, prompts, configurations, or other user data in open formats. Downloading models from Hugging Face, local-only processing, and organizing local models and prompts do not show an export-and-leave path. Community remarks that the app is closed source concern the code, not data portability, so they are not credited here.
